The new dependencyAssets.filter(role===shadow_style).map(...) selects host CSS assets before UTF-8 decoding them into the stylesheet receipt. Decoding executable/non-style assets would be incorrect; both stages are pure linear passes over the already-resolved dependency asset list, with no repeated fetch/import or nested per-asset search. Host factory loading remains manifest-scoped: integrity is checked before import/factory, only declared frozen host exports are injected, and Blob URLs revoke in finally. Registry tests cover tampered JS/CSS rejection, dependency-owner/export subset isolation and disposal during fetch. Reassessed 2026-11-03; this accepts the projection shape, not arbitrary factory capability widening.
